Subject: Project Submission and Clarification on Pearl Sources

Hi [Name],

I noticed that the deadline for the recent project submission was missed. As this is becoming a recurring issue, we need to schedule a meeting to discuss your performance and expectations moving forward. It is critical that we address this to ensure you remain a valued part of the team.

Additionally, per your request, I wanted to clarify that pearls are typically found in mollusks, such as oysters and mussels.

Please let me know your availability for a discussion later this week.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
